# `case`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
CASE expr1 WHEN expr2 THEN expr3 [WHEN expr4 THEN expr5]* [ELSE expr6] END
```

When `expr1` = `expr2`, returns `expr3`; when `expr1` = `expr4`, return `expr5`; else return `expr6`.
